questions.question: On an open highway, signal before turning. You must signal at least ____ before you start the turn.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 300 feet before turning or changing lanes on an open highway. This tells other drivers what you plan to do. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: They are placed wherever there is immediate danger.
They tell drivers what they must or must not do.
They are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
They warn drivers about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black text on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing zones, no turning rules, and other driving regulations.

questions.question: When can you honk your horn?

options.text: When you need to stop quickly
When you lose control of your car

questions.correctAnswerText: When you lose control of your car
questions.explanation: Use your horn when you lose control of your vehicle. Sound it to alert other drivers of the danger.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic going both ways, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming cars
Use the lane for oncoming traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane, two-way road, you must use the oncoming traffic lane. Only pass when it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: Why should drivers watch carefully for motorcycles, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic
They follow different traffic laws than cars

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are smaller and harder to spot than cars. They may move faster and have dimmer lights. Always watch for them to prevent crashes with these smaller, more vulnerable road users.

questions.question: There may be times when 10 mph is too fast to drive safely.
questions.explanation: Drive slower than the speed limit when needed for safety. Bad traffic, weather, or visibility may require you to drive as slow as 10 miles per hour or less.

questions.question: When driving 40 mph or slower, stay at least ____ behind the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: At 40 mph or slower, keep at least two seconds between you and the car ahead. This is the minimum safe distance. You can increase it whenever possible.

questions.question: On roads that are not freeways, look ahead at least ____ to see what is coming.
questions.explanation: Look 12 seconds ahead when driving on regular roads. On freeways, look 20 to 30 seconds ahead. Looking far ahead helps you avoid sudden stops or quick turns.

questions.question: When is driving below the speed limit illegal?

options.text: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly and blocking traffic is illegal. You can get a ticket for it.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Make your car need a tune-up sooner
Make you feel drowsy while driving
Start grass fires on country roads

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you feel drowsy while driving
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases and cools hot gases from the engine. A leak lets poisonous fumes into your car. These fumes can cause drowsiness while driving and can be fatal if you breathe too much.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, you should:

options.text: Always have the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are coming.
Enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop for you.
Use crosswalks only when it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are coming.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are coming. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a vehicle that is close may not be able to stop in time.

questions.question: It is unlawful for a car to share a lane with a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full traffic lane. Two motorcycles may share a lane, but cars may never share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different roads at the same time, which vehicle must yield?
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right. This rule applies whether the intersection has signs, signals, or neither.

questions.question: You are driving in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder in the direction you want to move. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A volunteer group is cleaning up trash on the highway.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: Traffic signals use arrows to control turns from certain lanes. A solid red arrow means:

options.text: This is not used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
Drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular traffic light. When an arrow is red, drivers in that lane must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. You must:

options.text: Wait for the police to arrive.
Leave a written note with your name, address, and details about the accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a written note with your name, address, and details about the accident.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car, stop and try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: You cannot parallel park within ____ of a fire hydrant.
questions.explanation: Do not parallel park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. Always park legally in a place where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: You reach an intersection blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly until the traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic is blocked ahead and you cannot completely pass through. Wait for traffic to clear so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road. If your vehicle rolls downhill, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.
questions.explanation: High speeds greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity. The faster you drive, the greater the impact if you crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of these except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your body weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: Which is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions.

questions.question: What should car drivers know about large trucks?

options.text: They can stop faster than cars.
They need the same space to turn as cars.

questions.explanation: Large trucks have large blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Stay away from these areas. Trucks need more room to turn and stop than cars.

questions.question: An oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Stay in your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.explanation: First, honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer to the right to escape. Do not steer left—if the other driver corrects at the last second, you will still crash. Brake firmly to reduce impact and lower your speed as much as possible.

questions.question: Your ability to stop is affected by:
questions.explanation: Road condition greatly affects your ability to stop. Slow down on slippery or poor roads to keep control of your vehicle and avoid skidding if you need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.
